# beast-civilization — llms-full.txt (v0.3.0 Compact Context Bundle)

`beast-civilization v0.3.0` is a zero-dependency polyglot bare-metal Agent Civilization & Evolutionary Compute Substrate unifying `nagisanzenin/{INIT-Agent,nonhuman,engram,effortmining,nagi,strictlybetter,crucible,math-first}`, `temm1e-labs/{temm1e,temrust}`, `tsotchke/{eshkol,moonlab,quantum_geometric_tensor,quantum_rng,rosette-wire,libirrep,PINN,spin_based_neural_network,tensorcore}`, `0thernes/{autophage,cellular-engine-omega,cellulogonic-mecha,noetic-organism-omega,planaria,alife-singularity-omega-package}`, and MIT/ICLR 2026 Cache-to-Cache / Swarm Telepathy across **Zig `0.17.1`**, **Rust `1.94.1` (7 crates)**, **CRuby `3.4.9`/Prism/YARV**, **C11 (7 live native DLLs)**, **NVIDIA RTX 5070 Ti `sm_12.0` 3-Kernel PTX**, and **32 Pure Lean 4 `v4.35.0` Theorems**.

Run `.\build.ps1` (6 layers: Zig `beast_metal.dll` + upstream `tsotchke_qrng_bridge.dll` & `tsotchke_pinn_bridge.dll` + freestanding `x86_64` Multiboot2 ELF v2 + 7-crate Rust workspace + 16-gate/16-mutant suite + 3-kernel RTX 5070 Ti PTX + 10-gen CRuby/YARV breeder + 32 Pure Lean 4 proofs).
